items.title: Iran threatens to make 'Gate of Tears' the world's next oil chokepoint
items.description: The opening of a new front in the Middle East war has put another vital shipping route on edge. Known in Arabic as the "Gate of Tears", analysts warn this narrow waterway could soon live up to its name.

items.title: Live: Pentagon 'preparing for weeks of Iran ground operations', WaPo reports
items.description: The Washington Post says the Pentagon's plans include conventional infantry troops plus raids by Special Operations, but are subject to approval by US President Donald Trump, as the Iran war stretches into a fifth week. Follow live.

items.title: Liberals dump Moira Deeming from ticket for next state election
items.description: Controversial Victorian MP Moira Deeming has lost her preselection battle for the state election, with Liberal Party members replacing her with business leader Dinesh Gourisetty.

items.title: 'Huge miscalculation': Liberal Party's Andrew Hastie criticises Donald Trump over Iran war
items.description: Coalition frontbencher Andrew Hastie warns the credibility of the United States is being damaged and says Australians may be losing faith in the alliance.

items.title: Labor wins blue-ribbon seat of Morphett from Liberals
items.description: Liberal frontbencher Stephen Patterson loses his bid to be re-elected in the beachside seat of Morphett in the South Australian state election.

items.title: Live: Titans and Dragons fight for first NRL win of 2026
items.description: Neither St George Illawarra nor Gold Coast have won an NRL game in 2026 but with the two sides facing off to finish Round 4 somebody will break their duck. Follow live.

items.title: Demons overwhelm Blues in late MCG surge
items.description: The Demons complete an amazing comeback and pile pressure on Carlton coach Michael Voss, while West Coast celebrates an inspirational victory on the road against Port Adelaide.

items.title: Piastri finishes second, ill-timed safety car denies him victory in Japan
items.description: An ill-timed safety car has denied Oscar Piastri a stunning Japanese Grand Prix victory, with Italian Kimi Antonelli benefiting to secure successive wins.

items.title: No transport relief for Sydneysiders as fuel prices surge
items.description: The NSW Liberals and the Rail, Tram and Bus Union (RTBU) have renewed calls for free public transport in response to surging fuel prices.

items.title: Australia aids Artemis II as NASA astronauts return to the Moon
items.description: Canberra-based communications systems will support NASA's first crewed lunar mission in more than half a century, helping astronauts orbit the Moon and return data.

items.title: 'It's a nightmare': Complaints pile up over Booking.com grievances
items.description: Hundreds of complaints against Booking.com are piling up as customers and hosts allege they have lost money, their property has been trashed and no-one is taking responsibility.

items.title: Annie is only 26, but will die within months. Here's what she wants you to know
items.description: Before ending her life through voluntary assisted dying, Annaliese Holland shares her final wishes and advice on living a full life.

items.title: 'No Kings' protests against Trump draw crowds across US and Europe
items.description: Huge crowds rally against US President Donald Trump from coast to coast in what organisers hope will be the largest single-day protest in US history.

items.title: 'A lover of life': Mal Leyland eyes off one final trip before dementia decline
items.description: Adventurer and filmmaker Mal Leyland, of Ask the Leyland Brothers fame, shares his private health battle. But the TV legend is determined to retrace the cross-country trip that made him famous 60 years ago.

items.title: Charlie was at the airport to pick me up. We've been 'us' ever since
items.description: After cancelling a full Sri Lankan wedding and a string of "disastrous" relationships, Sashi Perera found herself opposite a man who made believing in him simple.

items.title: Why the 'perfect pair' of jeans remains an elusive concept
items.description: The enduring challenge of finding the "perfect pair" of jeans highlights the garment's cultural significance, and the opportunity to move toward more sustainable and more thoughtfully designed denim.

items.title: Consider yourself a trivia nut? Have a crack at this quiz
items.description: We know you've come here looking for trivia glory but you're unlikely to find any today.

items.title: Confronting images of 'unprecedented' outback flood after cyclone
items.description: An outback cattle station and tourist ranch in WA's north has felt the full force of Cyclone Narelle, with vision emerging of the trail of destruction left by the powerful wind and heavy rain.

items.title: Kings one win away from NBL title after beating 36ers
items.description: The Sydney Kings edge a step closer to winning a sixth NBL championship following a 106-93 defeat of the Adelaide 36ers in front of a record crowd.

items.title: Roos star sent to AFL tribunal after alleged blood-wiping incident
items.description: North Melbourne ruckman Tristan Xerri is sent directly to the AFL tribunal on a charge of serious misconduct after he allegedly wiped blood on Essendon captain Andy McGrath's face.

items.title: Vital Aboriginal records saved in the 70s by an astute WA archivist
items.description: Margaret Medcalf, who turns 100 this week, insisted that decades of Aboriginal welfare records be preserved in the state archives and not destroyed. Those documents have proved essential to connecting Aboriginal people with their family history.

items.title: Mass casualty exercise in Adelaide draws details from recent events
items.description: South Australian emergency services conduct their largest mass casuality exercise in history in a bid to test coordination between agencies.

items.title: The extraordinary story of Australia's oldest living Olympian and his remarkable debut
items.description: Gordon "Wingnut" Ingate was twice denied time off work to compete in the Olympic Games in his 20s, but continued to excel as a sailor, eventually getting the chance to compete in his 40s at Munich 1972.

items.title: The unexpected type of man more women want to date
items.description: For the first time, more men than women are "marrying up" the education ladder, toppling a millennia-old tradition, an exclusive ABC analysis has revealed.

items.title: Carroll College to overturn 32-year ban on students walking to school
items.description: A misunderstanding between the Catholic secondary school and the local council led to the three-decade ban.
